title: Chapter 245: Zerg Puppy Fights Alone
content:
Chapter 245: Zerg Puppy Fights Alone

People from other races kept coming to the battlefield to receive spoils of war. It was very lively. After the Zerg spoils of war were all traded, the Zerg army withdrew from the battlefield and found a place nearby to rest.

The Zerg army suffered some casualties in the previous war. Their injuries and consumption all need time to recover.

The Zerg army does not need to camp. They can recover quickly by crawling on the ground. The Zerg can recover faster by burrowing underground, but it is not necessary. There is no need to care about this time now.

Except for the Zerg stealth spider and Zerg puppy, other Zerg troops have not yet exposed the ability to burrow underground.

Niu Zhong of the Ox Clan arranged for the tribe members to clean up the spoils of war they deserved, and then gathered the troops that would follow the Zerg to go on the expedition tomorrow and came to one side of the Zerg army to camp.

Niu Zhong brought nearly 200,000 elite troops of the Ox Clan. He should be thinking that if there is a chance, they will personally go into battle to kill the enemy and avenge their tribe members.

Before dawn, the Ox Clan's camp began to pack up and prepare to set off.

The Zerg has no logistics, so they don't need to pack up and can get up and set off directly.

There is still a long way from the current position to the main city beyond the lord's protection range. This safe distance can be traveled at night, so that you can reach the 66th city earlier.

Wu Qing saw the nearly 200,000 troops of the Niu tribe were moving out of camp, and sent someone to send a message to Niu Chong, telling him to only bring troops that can keep up with the speed of the Zerg army. If other troops and logistics teams must go, they should come slowly behind.

Then, the Zerg army showed Niu Chong what it meant to march fast. Seeing the gap between the two tribes' armies, Niu Chong finally led only the most elite cavalry troops in the tribe to follow.

The 200,000 elite troops of the Niu tribe, marching all day, are estimated to not reach the destination. If the Zerg army takes them, it will seriously affect the Zerg's combat plan.

The Queen of Zerg has calculated the marching route and time based on the information provided by Niu Chong. As long as the error of the information obtained is not too large, with the marching speed of the Zerg army, they should be able to reach the 66th city in the afternoon.

Goblins can be seen from time to time on the march of the Zerg army. Faced with such a large army, those goblins dare not come to harass, and the Zerg army also turned a blind eye to them.

Perhaps the annihilation of the alien human army gave the evil god camp army a certain deterrence, and they did not encounter a large-scale evil god camp army along the way.

At dawn, the Zerg army finally left the lord's protection range of the main city and entered the wild area.

The distance from here to the 66th city is that it may take many days for ordinary troops to march normally.

But the march of the Zerg army is almost not affected by external factors. The slowest marching army is also very fast. As long as they don't fight a few battles in the middle, it will not be a big problem to reach the destination in the afternoon.

Wu Qing's Zerg clone, surrounded by the Zerg guards, rode on horseback, looked at the scenery for a while, and then his consciousness left.

On the march of the Zerg army, Wu Qing didn't need to keep staring.

...

Underground world, Zerg territory.

The original territory of the ghouls is now full of Zerg nests. These nests have not been upgraded, are cheap, and can be built at will.

The main function of these nests is to receive the resources mined by the Zerg worker bees and convert them into system energy.

Their additional function is to cover the entire Zerg territory with a layer of Zerg fungus blanket. The place covered by the Zerg fungus blanket is the real Zerg territory.

The Zerg has completely occupied the original territory of the ghouls.

On the Zerg territory, countless huge Zerg worker bees are constantly mining resources and quickly transporting them to the nearby Zerg nests.

These Zerg worker bees have been upgraded. They don’t need many resources to upgrade, and their mining efficiency has been greatly improved.

In the case of sufficient resources, it is a very cost-effective investment to improve the star strength of the Zerg worker bees.

With the hard work of these Zerg worker bees, a large amount of system energy resource income makes it possible for the Zerg to have unlimited soldiers and Zerg puppies.

Zerg puppies hatched in groups in the Zerg territory and headed straight for the wilderness area of the underground world to strengthen the Zerg's troops in the wilderness area.

Thanks to the efforts of these Zerg puppies, the area between the Zerg territory and the underground dire wolf activity range has been basically explored.

In this explored area, the Zerg puppies will not actively attack the underground creatures in it, and will only observe and monitor those extremely dangerous underground creatures from a distance.

Wu Qing wants a normal underground wilderness area to observe and study, and enhance the Zerg's understanding of the underground world.

But the area where underground dire wolves appear is not a normal underground wilderness area. Those underground dire wolves are a group of ferocious hunters who hunt all underground creatures.

Wu Qing guessed that the area explored by the Zerg puppies should have been the hunting range of the ghouls, otherwise it would be impossible to explain how those skeleton blood pools came from.

The underground dire wolf tribe's crazy hunting should also be for the development of the race. The two races that the Zerg have come into contact with are races that hunt lives to develop. It can be predicted that the living conditions of ordinary creatures in this underground world may be more cruel than those in the aboveground world.

The number of Zerg puppies continues to increase. They come to the range of the underground dire wolf pack and begin to hunt the underground dire wolves in reverse.

The Zerg hive has been upgraded to five stars, and the Zerg puppies, whose strength has been improved again, have no rivals below one star.

Even if it is a one-star enemy, they can fight alone, and it is still easy to save their lives.

As long as there are two Zerg puppies to cooperate, they can even hunt down one-star underground dire wolves, and their strength is very strong.

Zerg puppies are elusive, sometimes gathering, sometimes dispersing, and using their abilities such as burrowing and lurking, they can easily hunt down the underground dire wolves hunting everywhere.

As long as the underground dire wolves are targeted by the Zerg puppies, no one can escape, so in the beginning, the underground dire wolves have not discovered the Zerg puppies as an enemy even though they have lost a lot of troops.

However, the underground dire wolves know that there are enemies in the direction of the Zerg territory. The large losses of the hunting teams outside the tribe still make them alert, and they sent some stronger underground dire wolf teams to patrol everywhere.

The main force of the Zerg is now deployed on the public battlefield in the southern theater. Wu Qing will not send the Zerg army to actively attack the territory of the underground dire wolf pack.

However, if the hunting action of the Zerg puppies can anger the underground dire wolf pack to actively attack the Zerg territory, that is what Wu Qing wants.

Therefore, the hunting action of the Zerg puppies is not taken into consideration. As long as there is a chance, they will start to kill and kill the underground dire wolf pack to continuously shrink the hunting range.

Some Zerg puppies followed the underground dire wolf pack that transported prey and continued to go deep into the territory of the underground dire wolf pack. After paying the price of a large number of Zerg puppies being besieged and killed, they obtained a lot of information about the underground dire wolf pack.

Entering the territory of the underground dire wolf pack, you can see a large number of wolf caves, and the prey hunted are sent to each wolf cave.

The situation inside the wolf cave cannot be explored for the time being. Each wolf cave is guarded by a powerful underground dire wolf. These wolf caves should be the breeding ground for race members as important as the skeleton blood pool of the ghoul clan.

In the territory of the underground dire wolf tribe, a large number of underground creatures are also kept in captivity. The ability to keep other creatures in captivity proves that the underground dire wolf tribe is very intelligent.

The Zerg puppies have also discovered underground dire wolves that can cast magic. The diversity of the tribe's arms has thoroughly confirmed their identity as a powerful race in the underground world.

The Zerg puppies have continuously eroded the underground dire wolf tribe's range of activities with endless numbers, and have brought a large number of underground wilderness areas under the actual control of the Zerg.

The underground dire wolf tribe has organized many counterattacks. The Zerg puppies fight when they can beat them, and run away when they can't beat them. They often burrow underground to ambush, making the underground dire wolf tribe powerless and become manic and helpless.

The Zerg puppies avoid the strong and attack the weak, and use their command and information advantages to constantly compete with the underground dire wolf tribe for consumption.

In such a battle, the Zerg will gain and lose, and can maintain this state for a long time, constantly suppressing the activity space of the underground dire wolf tribe.

For some unknown reason, the underground dire wolf tribe was unwilling to organize a large army to chase them out of their range of activities. They could only give up some of their original hunting areas and try to reduce conflicts with the Zerg puppies.

Wu Qing possessed the Zerg puppies distributed in the wilderness area of the underground world, and learned about the situation everywhere. He asked the Queen of Zerg to continue to use the existing tactics against the underground dire wolf tribe, and from now on, they would continue to consume their strength and prepare for the future war between the two tribes.

If the underground dire wolf tribe can't stand the harassment and actively attack the Zerg territory, then use the home advantage to fight them in advance.

If the underground dire wolf tribe keeps giving in, then they will continue to erode their living space, and wait for the Zerg to gain a foothold in the public battlefield of the southern theater, and find a suitable time to fight a big battle in the underground world.

...

After arranging the affairs of the underground world, Wu Qing turned his attention to the southern free land.

In the main battlefield of the camp war in the southern free land, Wu Qing was not in a hurry to let the Zerg participate for the time being. The Zerg's strength was basically invested in the public battlefield, which was the main battlefield, and this side could be slowed down first.

Moreover, Wu Qing has a new idea. He is going to enter the Southern Free Land in the name of the Alliance and participate in the camp war.

If the Zerg wants to fight the evil god camp here, they can open up another battlefield and fight the demons alone.

Through the information collected on the public battlefield, Wu Qing is no longer worried about the strong men in the evil god camp.

This is because Wu Qing considers that the Zerg will soon gain the status of a large clan, and then it will be difficult to personally participate in the affairs of the Southern Free Land. The combined strength of the entire Southern Free Land is very terrifying, and the Zerg needs to make friends with them.

As long as the Zerg does not intervene personally, but enters the Southern Free Land through an organization like the Alliance, it conforms to the rules of this world. Many large clans also have representative forces in the Free Land.
